thread:
claire: Preflight for tonight's 23:00 UTC change window. This rollout touches API (deprecation header), runtime (quant profile), console (session fallback), and router (session-token splitting). Need pins and any hard blockers now.
ben: Ack. Runtime pinned to v3.7.0. We'll enable quant-q4 in canary only. No hotpatches during the window.
rachel: Console ack. We'll keep legacy SESSION-TOKEN header fallback for 2 hours and enable verbose mismatch logging for 30m.
ben: Router team: session-token-split ready. Plan: 2% canary -> 10% (15m) -> 25% (30m) -> hold 30m. We'll emit TOKEN_A + TOKEN_B for split clients.
claire: Rollback criteria: session loss >0.6% absolute, auth 401s >0.5%, or p99 gen latency +120ms. Agree?
ben: I'll add a smoke step to deploy job: /health + 3 small/medium/long prompts. Abort on decode/token errors.
deploybot: deploy scheduled by @claire for change-window. target: runtime:v3.7.0, api:v2.11.0. canary: router.session-token-split -> 2% at t+3m.
oncall-bot: oncall rotation: ben (23:00-07:00 UTC). Pager rules active.
rachel: Console will emit synthetic sessions during canary and post CSV match rates every 10m here. If mismatch >8/min escalate.
ben: Canary started at 6321122350. Monitoring groups pinged.
claire: 10m smoke: console synth matches 99.5%, q4.errors 0, mobile auth clean. Proceeding to 10% in 5m.
ben: Observed a small p99 bump (+80ms) at 10% for long sequences. Within tolerance but keeping extended hold.
rachel: Small mismatch spike on two hosts; enabling host-level throttle for those hosts now.
ben: Throttle applied, mismatch dropped to 0.4/min. Pausing ramp until metrics stable for 15m.
deploybot: Canary paused at 10% for investigation.
claire: Good catch. Hold extended 15m. Resume only when mismatch <1/min and p99 delta <100ms for 15m. If threshold crossed, run rollback steps in the runbook.
rachel: Added console fallback instructions and mismatch log links to release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/6321122334/notes
ben: Runbook rollback snippet added: /deploy rollback --service runtime --to v3.6.9 --reason "session-token regressions" and /deploy toggle router.session-token-split off --env prod.
deploybot: Canary resumed to 25% at 6321122390. Monitoring ongoing.
claire: Thanks team. Closing thread unless we see alerts. Reopen if anything trips.
